pattern.description: A new chat bubble grows from a small pill into a full card below the conversation while the existing bubbles drift up slightly to make room.
pattern.why_premium: The reply slot appears before its text, so the conversation reads as live turn-taking; the gentle upward drift of the whole stack keeps the composition balanced instead of hard-jumping.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.bubble:not(.new)', {y: -30, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); tl.fromTo('.bubble.new', {scale: 0.3, opacity: 0, transformOrigin: '50% 0%'}, {scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power3.out'}, '<0.15');
build_hint.remotion: Existing bubbles: translateY = interpolate(spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200}}), [0,1], [0,-30]). New bubble: scale and opacity from spring({frame: frame-5, fps, config: {damping: 20, stiffness: 180}}) mapped 0.3->1, transform-origin top center.

notes: Upward drift of the existing bubbles is small (about 25-30 px); camera verdict is none so it is content movement. New bubble needed a manual box.
